name: atom-trap
description: Atom Trap: Neon. Build walls, trap bouncing atoms, clear the board.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vitest run && node scripts/licenses.mjs && vite build
scripts.android: npm run build:app && cap sync android
scripts.tune-puzzles: rolldown scripts/tune-puzzles.ts --file node_modules/.cache/tune-puzzles.mjs --platform node --format esm && node node_modules/.cache/tune-puzzles.mjs
